1.explanation: This example renders two DataTable instances side by side. In both, the batch action buttons use only icons and visible text children. In the first table (showIconDescription=false) we do not supply an iconDescription prop, so the component falls back to its default of 'Add', causing JAWS to announce 'Edit Add Button', etc. In the second table we explicitly pass iconDescription: '' to clear out the default, so JAWS will only read the visible label 'Edit Button', 'Reset Button', or 'Cancel Button'. This reproduces the bug and demonstrates the correct workaround until the default is fixed to an empty string when a visible label is present.
1.bug_scenario: In the two screenshots above you can see how JAWS reads out the accessible name for each of the batch action buttons. In the first example no iconDescription was provided, so both JAWS and Firefox pick up the default prop value of 'Add' and announce "Edit Add Button" or "Reset Add Button". In the second example iconDescription is provided, but is still duplicating the visible label text, so JAWS announces "Edit Edit Button", etc. In both cases the default of 'Add' is wrong (it should be empty string when there is a visible label) and iconDescription should only be required when there is no visible label at all.
